title: Where your stamp KTP data actually lives
description: Where your stamp KTP data actually lives: the records stay on your device, and a weekly check helps you see what is stored and tidy it up.
answer: When it matters, stamp KTP lives in three places, and the first one you open is already stale. IDMark keeps stamp KTP on-device, so it stays readable with no data plan and no account.

faqs: Can I open stamp KTP offline?
Yes. IDMark keeps everything on-device, so no data plan is needed.
Do I need an account first?
No. Start without login; export a backup from time to time.
With the shortest piece. Add scope only after two steady weeks.
What if I miss a few days?
Do not wipe history. Resume from the last entry and note one blocker.
